title: Gate decision
description: Structured output of a human node. Every gate resolution produces one of these; it feeds the audit plane. Free-text approval without a reason is not a resolution.

run_id.description: The run this gate belongs to.

gate_id.description: Gate id from the spec frontmatter.

reason.description: Why. Required for every decision, including approve; this is what makes override-rate and rubber-stamp metrics computable.

modification.description: Required when decision is modify: what was changed before proceeding.

decided_by.description: Human identity that resolved the gate. Must be an authorized reviewer for this gate class; must not be the spec owner.

escalated_from.description: Set when this resolution came from a timeout escalation; the originally assigned reviewer.

timed_out.description: True when the gate resolved via its timeout behavior (default_deny / reroute) rather than a human decision.
